scripts.lint: bun run lint:frontend && bun run lint:backend
scripts.format: bun run format:backend && bun run format:frontend
scripts.check: rm -f web/.vite-errors.log && bun run format && bun run lint && bun run build && bun scripts/assert-no-browser-errors.js
scripts.dev: cd web && php ../../backend/artisan optimize:clear && php ../../backend/artisan package:discover && concurrently --kill-others -p "[{index}] [{name}]" -n "laravel,laravel queue,laravel reverb,vite" "bun run serve" "php ../../backend/artisan queue:work" "php ../../backend/artisan reverb:start" "bun run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: cd web && php ../../backend/artisan optimize:clear && php ../../backend/artisan package:discover && concurrently --kill-others -p "[{index}] [{name}]" -n "laravel,laravel queue,laravel reverb" "bun run serve" "php ../../backend/artisan queue:work" "php ../../backend/artisan reverb:start"
